senses.gloss:
Pīyūṣa is found in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 in the sense of
the first milk of the cow after calving, ‘biestings.’ Usually
the term is applied metaphorically to the sap of the Soma
plant.^3
1) Cf. ii. 35, 5, where it is applied
figuratively to the mothers of Agni.
2) Kauśika Sūtra, xix. 15. Cf. Av.
viii. 9, 24.
3) Rv. ii. 13, 1; iii. 48, 2; vi. 47, 4;
x. 94, 8, etc.
Cf. Geldner, Rigveda, Glossar, 110.
